# Pauhu Builders

> Call Pauhu AI from programs and devices over HTTPS. Full machine guide: https://api.pauhu.ai/llms.txt

- OpenAPI: https://api.pauhu.ai/v1/specification
- Device firewall rules: https://github.com/pauhu/device-firewall
- MCP (streamable HTTP, secondary): https://api.pauhu.ai/mcp (Authorization: Bearer)
- MCP server card: https://api.pauhu.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
- A2A card: https://api.pauhu.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Offers and prices: https://api.pauhu.ai/v1/lds/outputs
- Changes: https://pauhu.ai/changes.json
- Community discussions (Announcements, Q&A, Ideas, Show and tell): https://github.com/pauhu/mcp/discussions

## We go further (Know-how × machines)

No more copy-pasting and clicking.

- Price, coming: one price per day of use for each device, each device with its own key; payments are not open yet, the price shows when they open
- Translate tool: coming: any language, on the device, with terms checked against official EU terminology
- Click steps: coming: where Pauhu can't act yet, numbered click steps, and running them as an acceptance test
- On the device: reading text in a photo and reading text aloud run in the browser on the device, free; more is coming
